title: Echo
content:
You know that feeling when you’re reading that one Manga or Manhwa, and you stumble across a stretch of panels so good you just sit there for minutes, replaying them in your head, playing director, imagining how cool they’d look in motion and how smoothly they’d transition?

I’m sure we’ve all had moments like that, especially while scrolling through the Solo Leveling Manhwa. I know I have.

The closest thing to that is finding a gem on YouTube where fans pour their creativity into producing something that gives back to the community. Most of the time, those are just impressive slideshows. But imagine the next evolution of that. How awesome would it be? That was Echo.

I’m not gonna lie, I was impressed. It quenched a kind of thirst I’ve always felt but never knew what it was. I’m satisfied.

Overall: 7.64/10.
